verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication product (to-dos, message boards, chat, card tables). AI-driven code-diff breakdown and explanation belongs to code-review and source-control tools, so this story is a category error for Basecamp. Nothing in the evidence shows Basecamp handling code diffs; its AI/MCP support concerns agents accessing Basecamp's own project data.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
